title: Whole-mount immunofluorescence staining of ECM gel-embedded pancreatic organoids
author: Beşikcioğlu, Yurteri, et al.

steps.title: Prepare PBS‑Glycine (10×) stock
steps.instruction: Make 100 mL of PBS‑Glycine (10×) solution for later dilution.

substeps.instruction: Add 7.5 g glycine to a 100 mL screw‑cap bottle.
Add 90 mL 10× PBS.
Stir on a magnetic stirrer until homogeneous.
Adjust pH to 7.4, then bring the volume to 100 mL with 10× PBS.
Re‑check pH and readjust to 7.4 if needed.
Filter the solution through a 0.2 µm filter.

steps.title: Prepare IF‑Wash buffer (10×) stock
steps.instruction: Make 100 mL of IF‑Wash buffer (10×) for later dilution, handling NaN₃ with care.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.5 g NaN₃ to a 100 mL screw‑cap bottle (wear double gloves, safety glasses, lab coat).
Add 1 g BSA (Fraction V).
Add 80 mL 10× PBS.
Add 2 mL Triton X‑100.
Add 0.5 mL Tween‑20.
Stir on a magnetic stirrer until homogeneous.
Adjust pH to 7.4, then bring the volume to 100 mL with 10× PBS.
Re‑check pH and readjust to 7.4 if needed.
Filter the solution through a 0.2 µm filter.

steps.title: Prepare fructose‑glycerol clearing solution
steps.instruction: Create a 100 mL clearing solution to replace mounting media and improve transparency.

substeps.instruction: Add 33 mL glycerol to a 100 mL screw‑cap bottle.
Add 7 mL distilled water.
Add 29.72 g fructose.
Stir on a magnetic stirrer.
Allow up to 2 days for the solution to become homogeneous (no crystals).

steps.title: Prepare 2 % paraformaldehyde solution
steps.instruction: Make 4 mL of 2 % PFA for fixation, handling PFA under a fume hood.

substeps.instruction: Mix 2 mL 4 % paraformaldehyde with 2 mL sterile PBS in a 15 mL conical tube.
Warm the 2 % PFA solution at 37 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 1× PBS‑Glycine solution
steps.instruction: Dilute the PBS‑Glycine stock to 1× and warm it.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 mL PBS‑Glycine (10×) stock to a 50 mL conical tube.
Add distilled water to a final volume of 50 mL.
Warm the 1× PBS‑Glycine solution at 37 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 1× IF‑Wash buffer
steps.instruction: Dilute the IF‑Wash stock to 1× and warm it.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 mL IF‑Wash buffer (10×) stock to a 50 mL conical tube.
Add distilled water to a final volume of 50 mL.
Warm the 1× IF‑Wash buffer at 37 °C.

steps.title: Set up warm working plate
steps.instruction: Prepare a 37 °C water bath plate to keep chamber slides warm during the protocol.

substeps.instruction: Fill a T175 flask with sterile water.
Add 3 drops of water‑bath sterilizer solution.
Close the flask with an unfiltered cap and seal with parafilm.
Warm the flask at 37 °C before any manipulation.

steps.title: Prepare blocking solution and block samples
steps.instruction: Make 2 % normal goat serum blocking solution and incubate samples for 1 h at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Mix 2 mL IF‑Wash buffer with 500 µL 10 % normal goat serum in a 2.5 mL tube (final 2 % serum).
Warm the blocking solution at 37 °C.
Aspirate the existing IF‑Wash buffer from all wells of the chamber slide.
Add 500 µL blocking solution to each well.
Incubate the slide for 1 h at room temperature (keep the slide on the pre‑warmed working plate).

steps.title: Prepare primary antibody mixture and incubate
steps.instruction: Dilute primary antibodies 1:250 in IF‑Wash buffer and incubate samples for 2 days at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: In a 2.5 mL tube, combine 10 µL each of anti‑E‑Cadherin (mouse), anti‑GFAP (rabbit), and anti‑β3‑Tubulin (chicken) with 2470 µL IF‑Wash buffer (total 2.5 mL).
After the 1 h blocking step, aspirate the blocking solution from each well.
Add 300 µL of the primary antibody mixture to each well.
Close the chamber slide cap and seal with parafilm to prevent evaporation.
Incubate the slide at +4 °C for 2 days (keep the slide on the warm plate when handling).

steps.title: Warm samples before washing
steps.instruction: Allow slides to equilibrate to room temperature to stabilize the ECM gel.

substeps.instruction: Remove the chamber slide from the refrigerator.
Let it sit at room temperature for at least 1 h.

steps.title: Wash samples with IF‑Wash buffer
steps.instruction: Perform three gentle washes with pre‑warmed 1× IF‑Wash buffer on a shaker.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate the primary antibody mixture from each well.
Add 500 µL pre‑warmed 1× IF‑Wash buffer to each well and shake at 20 rpm for 10 min at room temperature.
Aspirate the buffer.
Add 500 µL pre‑warmed 1× IF‑Wash buffer again and shake for 10 min at 20 rpm.
Aspirate the buffer.
Add 500 µL pre‑warmed 1× IF‑Wash buffer a third time and shake for 10 min at 20 rpm.
Aspirate the buffer.

steps.title: Prepare secondary antibody mixture with DAPI
steps.instruction: Dilute secondary antibodies 1:500 in IF‑Wash buffer and add DAPI for nuclear staining.

substeps.instruction: In a 2.5 mL tube, mix 5 µL each of Alexa Fluor 488 (mouse), Alexa Fluor 594 (rabbit), Alexa Fluor 647 (chicken), 2.5 µL DAPI (10× stock), and 2482.5 µL IF‑Wash buffer (final 1:500 for antibodies, 1:100 for DAPI).

steps.title: Add secondary antibodies and incubate
steps.instruction: Apply secondary antibody mixture to samples and incubate overnight at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate any remaining IF‑Wash buffer from each well.
Add 300 µL of the secondary antibody mixture to each well.
Incubate the slide at +4 °C for 24 h.

description:
We used this protocol for whole-mount immunofluorescence
staining of innervated pancreas organoids. This protocol protects the morphology
of inherent fragile structures such as axons and can be applied on other 3D
culture settings.Note: The
amount of described solutions are calculated for 8 well of 8 well
chamber slide.
